notes: the text splits at «فأما خالد وهشام فقالا»: Khalid and Hisham give Muhammad and Hafsa; Mansur gives Muhammad then Umm Atiyya; Hushaym later restates the Khalid route to Umm Atiyya (third group)
the Companion Umm Atiyya is named only in the Mansur and restated routes; the Khalid–Hisham route ends where the text names its last shaykh
«وفي حديث غير هؤلاء» and «أظنه قال فألقيناه خلفها» are wording remarks, left out; «وفي الباب عن أم سليم» and the fiqh remarks are compiler remarks, not links
